paper_metadata.title: Enhancing mechanical properties of γ/γ′ Co-Ni-Al-Nb-based superalloys through tailored adjustments

evidence.quote: The newly developed γ/γ’ Co-Ni-Al-Nb-based superalloys have emerged as highly promising candidates

three alloy compositions were developed, denoted as 2 V, 2 V8Cr, and 2V4Ta, corresponding to additions of 2 at% V, 2 at% V and 8 at% Cr, and 2 at% V and 4 at% Ta, respectively, to the base 23Ni8Al alloy

evidence.quote: Experimental alloy ingots were arc-melted with high-purity raw metals (Co, Ni, Al, Nb, V, Cr, Ta; > 99.9 % purity) in a Ti-getter argon atmosphere. Each ingot was flipped and re-melted at least seven times to ensure compositional homogeneity.
The as-cast alloy was homogenized at 1200 ◦C for 48 h to eliminate compositional segregation
followed by aging at 800 ◦C for 168 h to precipitate a fine γ’ phase microstructure

evidence.quote: Alloys in the Co-xNi-yAl-3Nb series exhibit well-defined γ / γ ′ microstructures with suppressed secondary phase formation.

evidence.quote: All three alloys exhibit a γ / γ ′ two-phase morphology.

phases_and_microstructures.material_state: annealed at 800 °C for 168 h after homogenization at 1200 °C for 48 h

attributes.morphology: coarsened and misoriented at grain boundaries; directionally aligned within grains

evidence.quote: the addition of 2 at% V (see Fig. 6 (a)) promotes the agglomeration of coarsened and misoriented γ ′ along grain boundaries and induces directional alignment of γ ′ within the grains, resulting in a reduced γ’ volume fraction of 47 %.

phases_and_microstructures.name: gamma prime (L12)
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: annealed at 800 °C for 168 h after homogenization at 1200 °C for 48 h

evidence.quote: In the 2 V8Cr alloy (see Fig. 6 (b)), the agglomeration of coarsened γ ′ at grain boundaries is mitigated, but the γ ′ in the grain interior rafts and exhibits an elongated morphology. The γ ′ volume fraction rises to 72 %.

phases_and_microstructures.name: B2
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: annealed at 800 °C for 168 h after homogenization at 1200 °C for 48 h

evidence.quote: Additionally, a minor B2 phase is observed along grain boundaries.

phases_and_microstructures.name: gamma prime (L12)
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: annealed at 800 °C for 168 h after homogenization at 1200 °C for 48 h

evidence.quote: In contrast, the 2 V4Ta alloy (see Fig. 6 (c)), uniformly distributed γ ′ precipitates are observed throughout the γ matrix. The γ ′ volume fraction reaches 80 %, and the fine γ ′ precipitates within the grains maintain a cuboidal morphology
